name: kotoshu-vscode
description: Semantic spell checking for prose files via the kotoshu-lsp language server

commands.title: Kotoshu: Add Word to Personal Dictionary

kotoshu-lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `kotoshu-lsp` executable. When unset, the extension tries `bundle exec kotoshu-lsp` when the workspace has a Gemfile, then a globally installed `kotoshu-lsp` found on `PATH`.

kotoshu-lsp.trace.description: Trace level of the language server communication, written to the Kotoshu output channel.

kotoshu-lsp.logFile.markdownDescription: File the server writes its own log to. Passed to the server as `KOTOSHU_LSP_LOG`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Leave empty for no server log.

kotoshu.checkCode.markdownDescription: **Experimental:** also check source code files. The server currently checks the entire file text — comment-only filtering is not implemented yet — so expect false positives on identifiers inside code. Requires a server restart to take effect.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test-compile && node out/test/runTest.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run check-manifest && vsce package --no-dependencies
